label: GO after a1->S1 rewarded; largest on first reward after a loss, early episode, high S1 belief
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * np.exp(-ep_trial / 30) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * np.exp(-ep_trial / 30) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * np.exp(-ep_trial / 30) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) * (tv("reward", -3) == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * belief ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == -1) * (prev_reward == 1) * np.clip(belief_lo, 0, 6) * np.exp(-ep_trial / 30) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == -1) * (prev_reward == 1) * np.clip(belief_lo, 0, 6)
explanation: Fires only at GO. Magnitude is driven by the previous trial being a1 -> S1 rewarded (common, rewarded); other previous-trial patterns (incl. a2 S2 r and a1 S2 r) leave it near zero. Within a1 S1 r it is graded: largest (~1.5) on the first reward after an unrewarded trial, smaller after two consecutive rewards (~1.1) and smaller again after three (~0.8), i.e. it decays with a run of rewards; it also decays across the episode (exp(-trial/30) shape) and grows with the ideal-observer belief that S1 is good. On the window first trial, where the previous choice/state is unknown, prev_reward == 1 times positive belief log-odds substitutes. Observed-only, no future variables. Test R^2 beyond timing 0.35 (dev 0.35) vs all-cue ceiling 0.38 and all-observed 0.30; a simple a1 S1 r indicator alone gives ~0.21 and belief alone ~0.13. The earlier firing label used the model policy (strong a1 commitment; policy decile alone 0.24); replacing it with belief plus reward-run history loses little, since the observed terms reach ~91% of the all ceiling, but residual variance remains unexplained.
